description: A study on vitamin C supplementation and tooth growth in guinea pigs is loaded in JASP (file: '/home/ga/Documents/JASP/ToothGrowth.csv'). The dataset contains 60 observations with three variables: 'len' (tooth length), 'supp' (supplement type: OJ = orange juice, VC = ascorbic acid), and 'dose' (dosage in mg/day: 500, 1000, 2000). Set up a complete factorial ANOVA analysis to examine the effects of supplement type and dosage on tooth length. Specifically: (1) Run a two-way ANOVA with 'len' as the dependent variable and both 'supp' and 'dose' as fixed factors, including their interaction effect. (2) Enable post-hoc comparisons for the 'dose' factor to determine which dosage levels differ significantly. (3) Enable descriptive statistics so that group means and standard deviations are reported. (4) Enable descriptive plots to visualize the interaction between supplement type and dose. (5) Enable eta-squared as the effect size measure. Save the completed analysis as '/home/ga/Documents/JASP/tooth_growth_anova.jasp'.
